Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
Rashtriya Krishi Vigyan Puraskar
Award Farmer Krishi Sciences Technologies
The Rashtriya Krishi Vigyan Puraskar under Indian Council of Agricultural Research
(ICAR),Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Government of India, recognizes
and honors scientists and technical personnel who have made outstanding
contributions in agriculture, agricultural education, extension, and allied sciences.
This includes the development of new processes, products, tools, technologies, and
innovative practices that enhance agricultural productivity and sustainability in
India.
Fields Covered:
The awards are categorized under three main streams, each covering the
following four fields:
1. Crops & Horticultural Sciences

Award Categories & Number of Awardees:
1. Innovation & Technology in Agriculture & Allied Sciences – 4 awardees
2. Research in Agriculture & Allied Sciences – 4 awardees
3. Outstanding Interdisciplinary Team Research in Agriculture, Agricultural
Education, Extension & Allied Sciences – 1 awardee
4. Outstanding Woman Scientist in Agriculture, Agricultural Education, Extension &
Allied Sciences – 1 awardee
5. Outstanding Young Scientist in Agriculture & Allied Sciences – 4 awardees
i. In the Award Ceremony, the Awardees shall be presented a Sanad (certificate)
signed by the Hon'ble Union Minister (Agriculture & Farmers Welfare) & President,
ICAR. A commemorative brochure, containing the citation and photograph of the
awardees shall also be released on the day of the ceremony.
ii. The decoration to such persons who are not able to attend the award ceremony
due to personal reasons (including indisposition, preoccupation, etc.) shall be
deemed to have been conferred. No other person (including the spouse/next of kin)
should be allowed to receive the award on behalf of the absentee awardee except
in posthumous cases.

2/8
Eligibility
General Conditions:
1. The applicant should be an Indian scientist working in agriculture or allied fields
in ICAR institutes, public agricultural institutions, or Krishi Vigyan Kendras, and
must have made significant contributions in India.
2. The applicant should have work (research, innovation, or extension) that shows
clear and proven impact on society, economy, or environment, supported by the
Head of the Institution.
3. The applicant can apply at any stage of their career, as no minimum service
period is required.
4. The applicant should submit only one application for a particular contribution in
a year, and the application will be valid only for that year.
5. The applicant should have a clean service record, with no pending enquiry or
major punishment in the last five years.
6. The applicant should apply under only one category and cannot be considered
for multiple categories.
Category-wise Conditions:
1. The applicant can apply individually or as part of a team (maximum five
members) for innovation and research awards, and must be below 60 years of
age.

3/8
Application Process
Online
2. The applicant applying for interdisciplinary research should be part of a team of
at least three members from different disciplines, and the team leader must be
below 60 years of age.
3. The applicant applying for the women scientist category should be a woman
working in agriculture or allied fields, and must be below 60 years of age.
4. The applicant applying for the young scientist category should have a doctoral
degree, hold a regular position, and must be below 45 years of age.
Registration:
Step 1: Visit the official website and click on the Registration button.
Step 2: Select your category: Individual or Organization.
Step 3: Fill in the required details:
Individual: Name, Date of Birth, Nominator Type, Mobile, Email, Aadhaar
Number.
Organization: Type, Authorized Person Name, Date of Birth, Organization
Description, Designation, Mobile, Email, Aadhaar Number.
Step 4: Click Submit to complete registration.

Apply:
Step 1: Log in to the portal using your registered credentials.
Step 2: Select the scheme from the list of awards and click "
Nominate / Apply Now".
Step 3: Fill in all mandatory fields in the online application form.
Step 4: Click Submit to complete your application.
1. Filled application
2. Details of your work
3. Proof your work helped people/environment
4. Documents (papers, patents, etc.)
5. Clean record certificate
